FAQ.question1: How far does the free plan go?
FAQ.answer1: The free plan lets you create up to 10 quizzes and use AI generation 10 times a month, with no limit on questions per quiz or the number of students. New accounts also get full Pro features for their first 30 days. If you need more, Pro is NT$299/month (NT$2,490/year) with unlimited quizzes and AI generation.
FAQ.question2: Do students need an account to take a quiz?
FAQ.answer2: No. Students scan the QR code or tap the link you share and answer right in their browser — no sign-up, no app. They see their score and explanations as soon as they submit, and you see the whole class's results live in your dashboard.
FAQ.question3: What materials can I give the AI?
FAQ.answer3: Type a topic or paste text, upload a PDF, Word file, image (JPG, PNG, etc.), or audio file (MP3, WAV, etc.), or paste a YouTube or Google Docs link. The AI writes questions in the types you choose — single choice, multiple choice, true/false, fill-in-the-blank, ordering, and short answer — with explanations. Free accounts get 10 generations a month; Pro is unlimited.

PracticeStats.title: Practice Page Analytics
PracticeStats.no_shares: This quiz has no practice page share links yet. Generate one via "Export as static practice page" in the quiz editor to see analytics here.
PracticeStats.empty: No responses yet. If this link was created before analytics existed, open "Export as static practice page" and click "Update to latest" on it to enable analytics (the URL stays the same).
PracticeStats.privacy_note: Anonymous practice analytics never record IPs, names or schools; emails are only collected when students opt in. Class and name under "Student scores" are entered by students when they submit.
PracticeStats.submissions_desc: Scores students submitted with "Submit" on the shared practice page (scores are recalculated by the server; class and name are self-reported).
PracticeStats.submissions_empty: No submissions yet. If this link was created before submissions were supported, generate a new share link (for multiple-choice pages you can click "Update to latest" and keep the same URL).
PracticeStats.fillblank_no_analytics: Fill-in-the-blank practice pages do not collect anonymous analytics; only submitted scores are shown here.
